references.text: God offers to make Moses into a great nation after the golden calf incident, a similar offer as in Num 14:12
God threatens to wipe out the people and make Moses into a mightier nation, the same theme as in Num 14:12
God's promise to make Abraham into a great nation, now offered to Moses instead
Pestilence (דֶּבֶר) is mentioned as God's instrument of punishment, the same threat as in Num 14:12
God threatens with pestilence to wipe out the people; the same Hebrew word דֶּבֶר is used
Pestilence is mentioned as a curse for disobedience, the same threat of דֶּבֶר
The promise that Abraham will become a great and mighty nation (גָּדוֹל וְעָצוּם), the same expression used in Num 14:12
Israel is described as a numerous and mighty people (עָצוּם), the same adjective as in Num 14:12
